I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust hitting “buy” again, especially with plants.

A bit about what makes Heirloom different on the quality side:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown at our nurseries in Oregon, not bought in from third-party growers. That means they’re started and raised under our care from the beginning.
We ship roses in 1‑gallon containers with soil, not bare root, so you get an actively growing plant with an established root system.
Every plant is hand-checked before it leaves the nursery.
We back our roses with a one-year guarantee and our perennials with a 90-day guarantee, so you’re not taking this leap alone.

To really make sure you don’t end up with the “wrong thing,” can you tell me:

Are you looking for a rose, a non-rose perennial, or bulbs?
Your ZIP code or hardiness zone?
The top 1–2 things that burned you in the past (plants arrived tiny, didn’t bloom, died quickly, didn’t match the picture, etc.)?
